desc:
[🐣] Cross Rivers for Animals

🥚 Grab an egg and RUN! The lilies are sinking! 🌊

Start in the Forest, cross the river and steal your first egg. Then train, get faster and push on through the Desert, Lake, Snow, Volcano, Abyss Ocean, Prehistoric and Cosmic worlds!

🦖 Every world has a guard watching the eggs
🐣 Hatch eggs into animals and pets, from Common to Cosmic
💸 Your animals earn cash, even while you're offline
🏃 Use your treadmill and trails to get super fast
🏏 Watch out for other players and their bats!

How far can you go? 🌊
